description: This map displays an aerial or satellite image of a European landscape, highlighting an "Exploited peat bog" as a prominent feature. The surrounding areas show a mosaic of other land cover types in various shades of brown and green, each demarcated by yellow polygon boundaries, indicating a heterogeneous landscape likely comprising forests, grasslands, and other wetlands.
